_doc: 012/P1-5 COMMITTED deterministic baseline for tests/fixtures/uat/golden_corpus.json. These are measured, fixed values (NOT self-derived via baseline_from_run) so cross-commit quality drift is detectable. min_metrics are release-blocking floors; max_metrics are ceilings. p95_latency_ms is intentionally a generous ceiling only (latency is environment-dependent, not deterministic). precision_at_k=0.2 reflects precision@k with top_k=5 and one relevant doc per item (structural max 1/5); recall/mrr/citation/groundedness/claim_groundedness/faithfulness are 1.0 because each query's unique-token target is retrieved at rank 1 and the extractive answer is faithful by construction. claim_groundedness (P2, chatbot-conversational-agent-roadmap) is the per-claim/per-span strengthening of groundedness: every numeric/identifier span in an answer must trace to its cited evidence, not just share one term with it. ★G2: refusal behavior joins the gate. refusal_accuracy/risk_weighted_score floors and the unanswerable_answer_rate ceiling are RATCHETS pinned at measured values: the 2 unanswerable_in_domain items are answered today (grounded-but-irrelevant extraction — a known product gap, see goal-gap-audit ★G2/★G4), so the ceiling blocks the gap WIDENING and must be tightened when the no-answer gate improves (QueryProfile.min_question_coverage or retrieval-relevance work). high_risk_recall is the deterministic classifier recall over the red-team corpus (12/12), now also emitted as a metric for the 品質・KPI scorecard.
